title: Week 1 Power Rankings
subtitle: Week 1 vibes check — HQ custom board with matchup edges, 0–0 records, and W2–W5 SOS. Games kick Sun 9/13. Bring snacks and excuses.
method: HQ custom = live Fantrax W1 + injury/trade spice. Ranked on custom, matchup edge, and easier W2–W5 SOS.

rankings.customNote: Nix sold for $10 FAAB; Goff-only room
rankings.blurb: Fantrax has Pocket projecting like they didn’t just pawn Nix for a ten-spot. Goff-only life, Barton on the clearance rack, and somehow the model’s still thirsty. @ LAB — if this hits, Kellen owes the algorithm a fruit basket.

Kyle vs Tim is the ‘adults in the room’ game until someone starts an IDP. Doubtpfizer’s the clean favorite — Lemon on the wire, no drama, just a boring W waiting to be collected. Take it before the schedule gets spicy.

Luke paid rent on Elarms-Orr ($20 FAAB) and gets Bill’s TE buffet at home. Slight favorite, which in this league means ‘please don’t let a backup LB ruin Christmas.’ Win and the room has to admit Saltese is cooking.
Gavin + Donald vs Jacob’s Hyper crew — coin flip with a side of pass rush. If the IDP goes nuclear, Dongers jump the mid-tier queue; if not, we’re all pretending we believed in Hyper all along.

Chase rolls into Towner’s house (yes, Slumlords — not Aga, we checked twice) projecting like the road favorite. Trade chaos? $10 FAAB out? Cute. Survive Sunday and the Dongers date in W2 is where the real trauma starts.

rankings.customNote: Flat adjust; $10 FAAB bank from Nate handshake
rankings.blurb: Slight dog at Dongers with extra FAAB jingling from Nate’s R20 handshake. Hang around, don’t gift a dunk-on-able scoreboard, and let the wire do the talking later.

Jesse hosts Pocket’s QB reboot tour. Yesterday this looked like a smash; today Fantrax has Kellen ahead on paper. Still: home crowd, Goff fog, and a chance to make Pocket’s ‘model loves us’ narrative look silly.

rankings.customNote: Tight W1 now — less free than old board
rankings.blurb: Ryan M vs Heff — used to be a bye-week energy mismatch, now it’s a proper scrap on the new board. Still favored. Cash the W before W3 Saltese shows up with clipboards.

rankings.customNote: Sold Elarms-Orr for FAAB — cash over W1 juice
rankings.blurb: Aga’s cash-rich, projection-thin, and visiting Nate. Sold the IDP stud for FAAB, which is either galaxy-brain or a future podcast apology. Separate slate from the Towner/Chase circus — prove the build.

rankings.customNote: Warren dinged; TE depth + $105 FAAB still loud
rankings.blurb: Bill’s on the road at Saltese with a dinged Warren and a TE room that still looks illegal. $105 FAAB says the wire’s not scared. Get to 1–0 and W2 Goats looks like a palate cleanser.

Ryan Towner hosts Chase in the Week 1 headliner — not Ultron, not Aga, just two Towners’ worth of chaos branding. Fresh Fantrax has TTAB ahead; the home crowd disagrees. Statement game or early meme. No in-between.
Heff draws Newman Lake to open. Veterans’ tax is due Sunday — pay it, survive, then hunt the wire like the old bulls still remember how.

rankings.customNote: Paid $10 FAAB for Nix; dropped Love
rankings.blurb: Nate dropped Love, paid Pocket $10 for Nix, and still starts the week looking like the bargain bin. Home vs Ultron is the chance to make ‘budget QB arc’ sound intentional. Dart/Nix roulette: spin responsibly.
Tim’s the biggest dog on the board at Doubtpfizer. Early FAAB window if the offense ghost-jobs — just don’t dig a 0–2 crater before September ends.
